## Description

The description the MCP server sends to the model, word for word. Its rules apply to every call.

> List the Substack newsletters this writer owns, each with publicationId, title and url. Call it when they name a newsletter, then pass that publicationId to list_my_posts or search_my_posts. These are their published newsletters; for WriteStack article drafts use list_article_newsletters.

## Arguments

This tool takes no arguments.
